summary: Map fan-in to a clamped node size
description: A pure function maps fan-in to a size between 4 and 24 inclusive. fan-in 0 is 4. A very large fan-in clamps to 24.
acceptanceCriteria: node_size(0) is 4, node_size(1) is 6, and node_size(100) is 24.
constraints: Strict TDD: write the failing test first and run it before implementation.
Do not add UI, watcher, or CLI code unless this task explicitly requires it.

subtasks.title: Clamp fan-in to size 4..24
subtasks.summary: Pure function. Formula 4 + 2*fan_in, clamped to 4 and 24.

relatedArtifacts.purpose: Node and Edge contract source of truth.

instructions: Write the failing test in tests/test_node_size.py first.
Run python -m pytest tests/test_node_size.py -q and confirm failure.
Run python -m pytest tests/test_node_size.py -q and stop when it passes.
